The '''L-s1 laser cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==History==
Both the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] models mounted a pair of these weapons. The L-s1 was eventually surpassed by the [[L-s7.2 laser cannon/Legends|L-s7.2 laser cannon]], which solved the L-s1's problem of overheating by adding coolant modifications.
